items.rationale: Call 1 sends 2,000. Call 2 resends the history plus the 3,000-token result, so it sends 5,000. The total is 2,000 + 5,000 = 7,000. Answering 5,000 counts only the last call; 10,000 treats every call as the final size.
Nothing is kept inside the model between sessions; the window ends with the session, so a fact has to be saved in a file or database outside it and read back in.
The model only asks for the tool call; the program runs the search and returns the chunks as text, the same rule as in the agent loop.
Bookings change constantly, so a saved copy goes stale; a live fact belongs to a calendar tool call. Notes can hold short sentences and be read in later sessions.
